title: Move tipper from 'home' to 'ready' by pressing CYCLE START
summary: After the tipper axes are homed to the 'home' position, press CYCLE START on the operator station control panel to move the tipper motor from 'home' to 'ready'.
when_to_use: Use when the tipper axes have been homed (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2) and the system is at the 'home' position, and you need to start the tipper operation cycle to move the motor to 'ready'.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the HMI actions (press CYCLE START) and verify the motor state changes from 'home' to 'ready'.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator station HMI screen/control panel with CYCLE START and home/ready state indication

system_preconditions: Tipper axes are homed to the 'home' position (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2).

visual_references.description: Operator Station Control Panel (Visu_MCP_Dual screen) showing the CYCLE START button and other tipper controls.
Operator station main screen image used in the startup procedure that includes the step to press CYCLE START and the expected 'home' to 'ready' movement.

steps.title: Confirm tipper axes are homed to the 'home' position
steps.purpose: Ensure the system is in the correct starting state ('home') before starting the cycle.
steps.instruction: Verify the tipper axes are homed so the system is at the 'home' position (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in the 'home' position state (ready to transition to 'ready' when CYCLE START is pressed).
steps.healthy_condition: The system indicates the tipper is at 'home' (not already in 'ready' or another state).
steps.failure_condition: The system is not at 'home' (axes not homed / not in the expected starting state).

actions.label: Verify homed state
actions.exact_action: Ensure the tipper axes have been homed (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2) so the system is at the 'home' position.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Home every axis: Z1 and A1 (left tipper) and Z2 and A2 (right tipper) … Press CYCLE START. The motor moves from 'home' to 'ready.'”

steps.title: Press CYCLE START to start the tipper cycle
steps.purpose: Initiate the tipper operation cycle that transitions the motor from 'home' to 'ready'.
steps.instruction: On the operator station control panel (Visu_MCP_Dual), press the CYCLE START button.
steps.expected_result: The tipper motor transitions from 'home' to 'ready' after pressing CYCLE START.
steps.healthy_condition: A state change occurs from 'home' to 'ready' following the CYCLE START press.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing CYCLE START does not change the state from 'home' to 'ready'.
stop_or_escalate_if: If pressing CYCLE START does not change the state from 'home' to 'ready', stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Press CYCLE START. The motor moves from 'home' to 'ready.'”
“The 'CYCLE START' starts the tipper operation cycle when the system is on 'Auto' mode.”

steps.title: Verify motor state changes from 'home' to 'ready'
steps.purpose: Confirm the cycle started correctly and the tipper reached the expected state.
steps.instruction: Observe the motor state indicator/state text on the operator station HMI to confirm it changes from 'home' to 'ready'.
steps.expected_result: The motor state changes from 'home' to 'ready' after CYCLE START.
steps.healthy_condition: The HMI shows the motor in 'ready' state (transition completed).
steps.failure_condition: The HMI continues to show 'home' (no transition to 'ready').

actions.label: Check state indicator
actions.exact_action: Observe the motor state change from 'home' to 'ready.'

stop_or_escalate_if: If the state does not change from 'home' to 'ready', stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Press CYCLE START. The motor moves from 'home' to 'ready.'”

success_criteria: After pressing CYCLE START, the tipper motor state changes from 'home' to 'ready'.
healthy_conditions: HMI indicates the motor is in 'ready' after CYCLE START.
failure_conditions: CYCLE START does not result in a state change from 'home' to 'ready'.
escalation_guidance: If pressing CYCLE START does not change the state from 'home' to 'ready', stop and escalate.
